description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Discussion concluded by Felix on 2026-11-12. People own graphs (d4203221): every graph is a repo on an Aimparency server, rights are per graph and enforced by that server, graphs link across servers by host URL. Git stays the storage and the history everywhere; no second storage engine, no database. License: no split into a free and a paid part ("I like that better! no split. just the intent backbone for open source"). No private graphs, to limit complexity and for the "parency".
